From the header's Judge (1)-(3): the car drives east and nobody at the checkpoint fires before the blast; the driver runs TriggerIed; the charge bursts with the APC (400,300) within 15 m - four one-sided burst bounds (x 385-415, y 285-315, the car on its y=300 route); the soldiers are hurt. 'At the car' is the same bound (the car is 8 m/s on that route); the blast row's shooter is not constrained (the live check accepted driver, charge or car).
